---
name: prd-interview
description: Interview me about PROPOSAL.md, then write PRD.md for a static website.
disable-model-invocation: true
---

Read PROPOSAL.md and any sketch I attached. Interview me so we can write a PRD
for a static website. Do not create or edit any file until I say "write it".

- Ask in rounds of at most three numbered questions. For each one, give your
  recommended answer and one line on why. Then stop and wait for me.
- Settle focus first: who visits, and the one thing they must be able to do.
  Do not ask about colors or fonts until that is settled.
- Version 1 is a static site: HTML, CSS, a little JavaScript, on GitHub Pages.
  If an idea needs a server, a database, logins, payments, or saved form data,
  suggest a static stand-in and put the full feature on a Later list.
- Keep version 1 to three to five pages I can build and check by the due date.
- Never invent content. If I do not have something, record it as missing and
  who will provide it.
- If a question can only be answered by seeing something, say so, and suggest I
  try two quick versions instead of guessing.

When I say "write it", write PRD.md with these sections: Goal, Audience and key
action, Pages, Navigation, Content (have / missing / from whom), Look (as
values for a :root block), Checks (three to five things a visitor must be able
to do), Out of scope, Later.
